headline: A demand plan with safety stock, Sajid's B2B models live, and a faster hourly refresh

stats.label: safety stock on November's consumer plan
B2B models from Sajid's handover now live

items.title: Stock-outs no longer shrink the forecast
items.detail: Days a product was out of stock are left out of its daily rate and growth, so a stock-out isn't read as falling demand (Chocolate Cookies in September).

items.title: Demand View: 4 months actual + 3 months forecast
items.detail: One pivot per SKU with actual, current and forecast months, and a flag on SKUs that were likely out of stock.

items.title: Per-SKU safety stock in the plan
items.detail: Plan units = forecast + a buffer from each SKU's own week-to-week swings (90% service level). In the backtest it ran short 3.8% of the time, against about 4.4% for a flat buffer.

items.title: Sajid's B2B ops models live
items.detail: 33 models for POs, GRNs, inventory and invoices now rebuild daily in dbt, in the existing schemas, with nothing else changed.

items.title: November plan frozen on the 1st
items.detail: The monthly snapshot saved November's plan with safety stock for all 5,394 rows, so production plans on a number that doesn't move.

items.title: B2B Uniware data every 15 minutes
items.detail: B2B sale orders, gatepasses, purchase orders and master inventory now sync on a new 15-minute schedule.

items.title: Uniware history back to April
items.detail: B2B sale order items, gatepasses, purchase orders and GRNs backfilled for April–July, so Sajid's reports cover the full year.

items.title: Demand tests made reliable
items.detail: Fixed a race between the order sync and the demand build that failed the daily run on two days.

items.title: Uniware login retries on outages
items.detail: A short Unicommerce login outage now gets retried instead of failing every stream (it had failed 87 runs on 27 Oct).

items.title: Hourly staging run 35% faster
items.detail: New indexes on the order tables and a leaner shipment model cut the hourly refresh from 420 to about 270 seconds.

items.title: Metabase cards off raw tables
items.detail: Three cards (Meta campaigns MoM and two Shopify cancellation reports) now read clean staging and reporting tables, with identical numbers.

items.title: Shopify admin app: stack proposal
items.detail: The manager asked for an in-house app inside the Shopify admin. Proposed a custom embedded Shopify app that shows our stock, shipment and demand data on order and product pages.

items.title: Demand history back to January
items.detail: Checked how far back clean demand goes for projections, and found which months need an older warehouse added.
